init_HybridShardLosslessDistributor: initialize a HybridShardLosslessDistributor with a param group and optional runtime config for lossless distributed Shampoo optimization
update_params: update model parameters using blocked search directions with ROUND_ROBIN or REPLICATE param assignment strategy
get_params_or_grads: get assigned parameters or gradients from the param group as an iterable of tensors
refresh_assigned_full_params: refresh cached full parameter tensors after loading a checkpoint to avoid stale optimizer values
construct_local_block_info_list: construct the local block info list for assigned parameters given source ranks and group rank
